entities.summary: Ulf Erik Isaksson was a Swedish ice hockey player who played one season for the Los Angeles Kings in 1982–83. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1971 to 1988, was mainly spent with AIK IF in Sweden. Internationally, Isaksson played for the Swedish national team at the 1981 and 1982 World Championships.
